name: After Effects Null And 3D Camera Scene Motion
use_when: A full-screen Reel animation needs spatial movement across icons, numbers, text boxes, or proof objects.
A flat scene feels static and needs controlled parallax or camera movement.
The animation needs multiple scene views within one spoken segment.
avoid_when: Simple 2D position/opacity motion already communicates the idea.
The viewer needs to inspect evidence and camera motion would reduce readability.
The scene has too many text layers to stay readable during a camera move.

timeline_pattern.pattern: build_scene_layers -> parent_related_layers -> create_null_or_camera_orbit_null -> convert_needed_layers_to_3d -> keyframe_camera_or_null -> start_motion_before_scene -> trim_camera_to_scene -> preview_one_view
timeline_pattern.null_rule: Use a null object to move grouped layers when direct background keyframes would conflict with earlier scene keyframes.
timeline_pattern.camera_rule: Use a camera plus orbit null when the scene needs zoom, depth, or multiple spatial views.
timeline_pattern.motion_rule: Start important camera/null motion slightly before the visible beat when the scene should already feel alive.

motion.rule: Ease every camera/null move and refine the speed graph so movement carries the viewer between focal points instead of drifting randomly.

keyframe_values.camera_range: Trim each camera and orbit null to the exact scene range.
keyframe_values.motion_overlap: Let camera/null motion begin a few frames before the visual beat when static starts feel dead.
keyframe_values.easing: Use Easy Ease and speed graph shaping; avoid linear camera moves.
keyframe_values.depth: Convert only layers that need camera response to 3D; keep backgrounds 2D if camera movement reveals unwanted edges.

sound.rule: SFX should mark scene transitions, icon entrances, or camera reveals only when they help the viewer feel the motion.

captions.rule: Suppress or relocate captions during dense 3D camera scenes unless they are required for comprehension.

color.rule: Use consistent background and icon colors so camera movement feels like one scene, not pasted assets.

implementation.ffmpeg: Approximate grouped moves with overlay transforms and zoompan, but use AE/Remotion for true scene-camera behavior.
implementation.remotion: Represent scene layers with parentId, transform, is3D, cameraFrames, and focalTarget fields; interpolate camera and layer transforms with easing.
implementation.blender: Use camera, empties, and parented objects for true 3D motion when assets need depth.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Use keyframed groups/compound clips when available; otherwise simplify to 2D pan/zoom scene movement.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Send dense animated scenes to After Effects; use nulls, 3D layers, cameras, orbit nulls, and trimmed camera ranges.

common_mistakes: Converting every layer to 3D and revealing background edges during camera motion.
Starting camera movement exactly on the cut so the scene feels static first.
Using a null when direct layer keyframes would be simpler.
Leaving camera or orbit null layers longer than the scene they control.
Making camera movement impressive but not tied to the spoken concept.
qc: Camera/null motion has a named focal target or transition job.
Only intended layers respond to the camera.
No background edges or empty areas are revealed.
Camera and orbit null layers are trimmed to the intended scene range.
Captions and key text remain readable through the move.
